## Validation

Relevant checks, synthetic regression coverage, and any separately authorized
acceptance. Distinguish implemented, accepted and deployed. Never attach private
media, runtime databases, local paths, tokens, operational logs or task receipts.

New commits require renewed review. Shared GitHub credentials do not establish
independent reviewer identity. Resolve review threads and pass required CI.
